quest.title: The Two Musketeers' Triumph
quest.description: This is the day that the winner of the Furina Award shall be revealed at the Fontinalia Film Festival. This is no time for delay. Time to head down to the venue!
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to the Fontinalia Film Festival venue

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xavier! It's been a while!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Hey there, you two. Sorry I've been scarce, I've been buried in marketing and preparing the film for release ever since we wrapped post-production...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The award ceremony is today, right? Paimon wonders if we'll win the Furina Award!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: I'd give it a ninety percent chance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Furina! Paimon didn't know you were already here. You're earlier than everyone else!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: I'm sure the others will also be here in no time. Hmm... Xavier, if we end up getting called on stage, shouldn't you come up with a name for our crew?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Huh!? But we don't even know if we're going to win. I wouldn't want to jinx our chances by celebrating early...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Just open your eyes! Surely you've seen the audience's reactions to our film? We've had nothing but critical acclaim!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: You've also had conversations with the opera house's operating staff, right? Didn't they want to increase the number of showings?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: With the Mora you've made from the box office, you can now open your very own film company!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: B—But that's all credit to my amazing crew! You've all helped to make this a reality, so I can't be the only one asked to come up with a name!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Well, give it some thought. I'm sure the crew will respect your choice.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: #Alright... But before that, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, could I trouble you to quickly pay a visit to the Fortress of Meropide?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But shouldn't we stay for the award ceremony?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I wanted to ask you two to invite Chevreuse to join us at the ceremony. She's one of the lead roles, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I haven't been able to find her recently, so I haven't had the chance to invite her personally.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: According to the papers, the culprits of the musket murder case will be personally escorted today by the Captain of the Special Patrol to the Fortress of Meropide...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It'll be a piece of cake for us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep! Just wait here, Xavier, and maybe try to come up with a few snappy sounding names.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Alright, then I'll leave you to it.

talks.objective: Go to the Fortress of Meropide to look for Chevreuse

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: This is as far as I'll be taking them. I'll leave the three of them to you now.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Got another errand to run?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Something like that. I'm expected at a party.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Now that's something you don't hear every day. Found a new pastime?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: No, it's just a special occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chevreuse, Wriothesley!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Festivals really do bring people together. It's been a while since I last had so many visitors at the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Call it the festival spirit, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Yeah, you could say that. Even our head nurse has gotten herself all worked up preparing super deluxe nutritious shakes... Just one gulp, and you'll have met all of your nutrition needs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Were you talking about work just now?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We've already finished discussing everything. So, what do you think about my "heads-up," Mr. Wriothesley?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Hmm. I believe I haven't yet made any promises or guarantees.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: But you also didn't shoot me down.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Here, how about this? You could give everyone a copy of the newspaper. Perhaps on the day when the cover story happens to, oh, I dunno, expose a certain someone's misdeeds from 20 years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Hmm. I suppose then, a certain someone may soon find himself the most unlucky person in the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: While another two people will soon be hailed as heroes.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Speaking of heroes, did you two need something from me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, actually we're here for...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: You're here to invite me to the party, right? Don't worry, I didn't forget.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, then let's head back right away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See ya, Wriothesley! Happy Fontinalia Festival!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: And the same to you.

talks.objective: Return to the Fontinalia Film Festival venue

dialogues.speaker: Film Festival Host
dialogues.text: And the winner of the Furina Award for the first Fontinalia Film Festival is—

dialogues.speaker: Film Festival Host
dialogues.text: "The Two Musketeers"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We won! We really won!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Congratulations, Mr. Xavier.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: We won... I can't believe it, I... I... I really can't thank all of you enough!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: See? My takes on Fontaine's entertainment industry have never been wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Film Festival Host
dialogues.text: Now, please welcome to the stage the producer of "The Two Musketeers," Mr. Xavier!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Thank you... Thank you all so much for your recognition and support. While I'm up here, I would like to give special thanks to—

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Time really flies, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It certainly feels that way. It feels like it was only yesterday when you were teaching me to hold a musket.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Will you come back to Fontaine again?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Of course! I'm very fond of this city. There are so many novel and interesting things that it's been hard to keep track of them all.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But how about you? Would you be interested in visiting Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I can't say the thought has crossed my mind before... but I'd be willing to consider it now.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I will be eagerly awaiting your visit. It would be wonderful if you could visit my home and enjoy a taste of our tea and desserts.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Yes, let's keep in touch.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Did you accomplish all you came here for?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Yes. And you should visit Inazuma again sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: How has Ogura and her business been?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: To my knowledge, she's been doing quite well.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Tell her I said hi.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: I certainly will.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I heard the thunderstorm has stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Yes, and the war has also been brought to an end. Peace and prosperity has returned to the islands.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I quite like the sound of that, perfect for hanging textiles out to dry.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: —I'd like to offer my thanks again to the entire cast and crew. Without you, I would have never completed this film, much less had the opportunity to be standing on this stage.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: With the support of my entire crew, I would like to officially announce our film company, "Musketeer Pictures"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that has a really nice ring to it!

dialogues.speaker: Film Festival Host
dialogues.text: Then, in that case, let's please welcome all the members of Musketeer Pictures onto the stage for a commemorative photo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Paimon didn't know we'd also be taking pictures!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Director Furina, I believe you are the most deserving person to raise this trophy.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Huh? No, no no no, there's no need... It's so embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: It's an honor the director deserves.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, I agree.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't think of anyone better for the honor.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Just accept that you're not getting out of this.

dialogues.speaker: Film Festival Host
dialogues.text: Ready, everyone? Three, two, one—

dialogues.speaker: Crowd
dialogues.text: Musketeer Pictures!!!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Will we really win an award...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Trust me. When have I ever been wrong about something like this?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Please go and enjoy the festival.
